business_name.title: Business name
business_name.description: The place or business name as displayed on Google Maps.

category.title: Category
category.description: Primary Google Maps category for the place.

full_address.title: Full address
full_address.description: Complete address shown on Google Maps.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number listed on Google Maps, or null when unavailable.

website.title: Website
website.description: Official website URL listed on Google Maps, or null when unavailable.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Average Google rating from 1.0 to 5.0, or null when unavailable.

review_count.title: Review count
review_count.description: Total number of Google reviews found for the place.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude coordinate parsed from the Google Maps page URL.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude coordinate parsed from the Google Maps page URL.

google_maps_url.title: Google Maps URL
google_maps_url.description: Direct Google Maps URL for this place.

place_id.title: Place ID
place_id.description: Google Maps place identifier or feature token parsed from the URL.

website_email.title: Website email
website_email.description: First public email found during optional website contact scan, or null.

facebook_url.title: Facebook URL
facebook_url.description: Facebook profile URL found during optional website contact scan, or null.

instagram_url.title: Instagram URL
instagram_url.description: Instagram profile URL found during optional website contact scan, or null.

linkedin_url.title: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile or company URL found during optional website contact scan, or null.

x_url.title: X URL
x_url.description: X/Twitter profile URL found during optional website contact scan, or null.

is_permanently_closed.title: Permanently closed
is_permanently_closed.description: True when Google Maps marks the place as permanently closed.

scraped_at.title: Scraped at
scraped_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this place record was extracted.

source_query.title: Source query
source_query.description: The search query, location, or Google Maps URL that produced this record.
